requestedText: Add a deterministic provider-agnostic Telegram Markdown summary boundary for explicit Weekly Radar facts.

evidence: The renderer stores and formats in-memory explicit facts only; it has no runtime loading, network, or dynamic reference mechanism.
No publisher or external adapter is added; later delivery work consumes the immutable TelegramMessage boundary.
The Work Item adds no telemetry, monitoring, delivery, HTTP, or provider integration.
The Contract declares an additive interface renderer and explicitly excludes domain calculation, provider integration, architecture-test, and global-policy changes.
WR-007 archive evidence supplies the upstream explicit change-section boundary.
